fullContentHtml:
SAV Bihar Class 6 Dummy Admit Card 2027-28 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the Dummy Admit Card for the Exam of Class 6 (VI) in Simultala Awasiya Vidyalaya (SAV), Simultala Jamui, Bihar To The Academic Session 2027-28 Admission on the official website of the BSEB recently. Applications for the SAV Bihar Class 6 Online Form 2026 were accepted from 03 August 2026, to 28 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SAV Bihar Class 6 Dummy Admit Card 2026-27 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 August 2026
  • Last Date : 28 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Mains Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Dummy Admit Card Available : 09 September 2026
  • Pre Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General/ BC / EBC / EWS : Rs. 200/-
  • SC/ ST Candidates : Rs. 50/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
